name: eight-months-of-silence-hard-constraints
description: Existing project rule IDs preserved; source scopes corrected to the actual Yumiwa tree. No runtime enforcement implied.

scope_resolution.rule: Resolve exactly one active root. Scope checks must not silently match zero files. Scope exclude is limited to the rule containing it.

rules.description: Yumiwa.Domain remains engine-free: no Unity namespaces or engine/package assembly references; noEngineReferences must remain true.
rules.verification: Assembly flag/reference check plus manual source review.

rules.description: Presentation code must not implement gameplay business rules directly (mission legality, puzzle-solution checks, evidence validity). It may only call Application services.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: No circular references between Assembly Definitions.
rules.verification: Local asmdef graph cycle check; external package compatibility needs the actual Unity project.

rules.description: Gameplay Presentation uses Domain/Application contracts, not concrete Infrastructure types. GameLifetimeScope composition-root wiring and Editor-only tooling are the precise ADR-0018 exceptions.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

exceptions.reason: Composition-root wiring and Editor-only setup; not gameplay business logic.

rules.description: No runtime scene-wide dependency search: FindObjectOfType, FindObjectsOfType, FindFirstObjectByType, FindAnyObjectByType, FindObjectsByType or GameObject.Find. Use explicit injection/references; one-time Editor tooling is the documented exception.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Forbid new public static X Instance singleton fields holding mutable gameplay state.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Forbid legacy Input Manager calls; New Input System only.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Forbid empty catch blocks that swallow exceptions silently.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Forbid async void methods except recognized Unity event entry points (Start, Awake, OnEnable, OnClick handlers).
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

exceptions.reason: Existing accepted lifter only; does not validate atomicity, concurrency or future async-void methods.

rules.description: No Resources.Load for new content. Preserve documented guarded Resources.GetBuiltinResource font fallback only within its existing ADR-0011 scope; do not treat it as an Addressables implementation.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Review MonoBehaviour responsibility and combined size across all partial files. About 200 lines is a review trigger; splitting one class into partial files does not resolve coupled responsibilities.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

exceptions.reason: Existing named prototype debt only; not blanket approval for new oversized classes.

rules.description: Save serialization changes require the project decision/ADR gate and an explicit compatibility/migration plan. Verify completion, independent chapter/house stores, failure handling and requested restore semantics; a version field alone is not a migration.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: For new Domain/Application behavior and public methods, follow the existing EditMode test requirement with meaningful normal/edge/invalid-input cases. Behavior bugfixes need a regression test where testable; existing fake-only coverage does not prove runtime integration.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Numeric/string literals used for gameplay tuning (damage, timers, thresholds) should come from a ScriptableObject asset, not be hardcoded in a class body.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: For changed runtime C# or Unity scenes/prefabs/assets/input actions, perform current MCP Play+Execute, current compilation and fresh console checks, with screenshot/state evidence. Verify the actual affected player mechanic and stop Play Mode. Unavailable required runtime means BLOCKED, never PASS.
rules.verification: Live Unity MCP execution evidence only; not enforced by the static validator.

rules.description: R1 Rujukan Wajib: Setiap keputusan desain/konten harus traceable ke file spesifik di docs/ (contoh: docs/03-core-gameplay-systems.md §Aturan Evidence). Laporan wajib cantumkan rujukan file.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: R2 Larangan Fabrikasi Kanon: Dilarang mengarang fakta naratif, nama karakter, tanggal, angka gameplay final, atau keputusan desain yang belum ada di docs/. Gunakan placeholder eksplisit + tandai asumsi sementara.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: For new gameplay/content, explicitly check grounded horror movement, meaningful inspection and narrative investigation through player action, plus the experience principles in docs/02-design-pillars-vision.md. Preserve supporting design constraints in docs/GDD.md; report actual conflicts.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: R4 Scope Gate: Cek docs/10-production-scope.md sebelum implementasi. Fitur di 'Di Luar Scope Awal' (open world, multiplayer, procedural, skill tree, crafting kompleks, loot rarity, multiple ending, full voice) wajib eskalasi eksplisit.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: R5 Anti Soft-Lock: Setiap sistem item/evidence/progres wajib cek docs/03-core-gameplay-systems.md aturan anti-frustrasi. Desain yang bisa soft-lock permanen harus ditolak atau diberi recovery path.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Preserve the project content/rating direction in docs/01-project-overview.md. This is a creative scope rule, not a claim of external rating certification.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: R7 Konsistensi Lintas Dokumen: Ubah/tambah topik harus cek dampak ke docs terkait (karakter Bab3 ↔ 04-narrative-and-characters.md). Jangan buat kontradiksi antar docs/*.md.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: R8 Transparansi Batas Kemampuan: Jika task butuh keputusan gameplay/naratif milik game director/lead manusia, agent harus state eksplisit, bukan memutuskan sepihak.
rules.source: docs/00-index.md and relevant numbered GDD document
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: TBD Diketahui: 9 item di docs/12-references-and-open-tbd.md tidak boleh diputuskan sepihak. Kerjakan bagian non-TBD, tandai output dengan <!-- TBD#N --> + 2-3 opsi, jangan hapus TBD dari docs/12.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: If a new unresolved design fact is required, stop the dependent decision, state the gap and concrete options, and obtain the direction required by AGENTS.md. Complete independent authorized work; do not fabricate an answer or erase the TBD.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; any match expression is a heuristic, not a complete C# analyzer.

rules.description: Yumiwa.Application is engine-free in the supplied asmdef: references Domain only, noEngineReferences true. Do not import Unity types based on the older architecture example.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; ARCH-005 assembly flags/references also checked by static validator.

rules.description: Discover and invoke applicable installed skills as required by AGENTS.md. Distinguish a file read from invocation; absent/broken required skills block their operations and must be disclosed.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; no automatic enforcement claimed.

rules.description: Use actual exposed Unity/context7 MCP capabilities for operations required by AGENTS.md. Select the correct Unity project/instance. No raw bridge, Unity YAML edits, hidden tool replacement or permission changes to bypass an unavailable capability.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; no automatic enforcement claimed.

rules.description: Record PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN/NOT_APPLICABLE honestly with evidence. Historical claims, file presence and static checks cannot be promoted to current compile, runtime, tool-invocation or performance proof.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; no automatic enforcement claimed.

rules.description: Preserve existing Unity .meta identities and serialized references. Renames/type changes need a planned migration and live editor verification; never recreate GUIDs or hand-edit YAML to force a pass.
rules.verification: Manual evidence review; no automatic enforcement claimed.
